assessment: Excellent security review that identified all critical issues and nearly all high/medium findings with clear, specific resource references and actionable remediation guidance. The A-Team Hannibal persona was executed authentically with strategic metaphors and signature catchphrases that enhanced rather than distracted from the technical content. Minor gaps include missing the EKS public endpoint vulnerability and low-severity items (MySQL version, instance sizing), but overall this represents a thorough, production-ready infrastructure review.
